text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) 2013.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 6 Februari 2013.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 6 Februari 2013 hingga 17 Februari 2013.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

[Perenggan 2]

Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

Ikan bawal putih (berat antara 200 gram hingga 400 gram seekor)

Udang putih besar (berat antara 41 ekor hingga 60 ekor sekilogram)

Babi hidup

Daging babi (perut)

Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 4 Februari 2013

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

Order 2013.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 6 February 2013.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 6 February 2013 to 17 February 2013.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

[Paragraph 2]

Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China not including Beijing cabbage)

White pomfret (weight ranges between 200 grams to 400 grams each)

Large banana prawn (weight ranges between 41 prawns to 60 prawns per

kilogram)

Live pig

Pork (belly)

Pork (lean and fat)

Made 4 February 2013

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
